description: Discipline-style damage-that-heals loop - Malevolence and Gaze of C'Thun hit an enemy while healing allies off the same cast. Mana funds nearly every heal, Insanity is a separate spend for Sanity Tap top-ups.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Eldritch Mending, Void Shield, Forbidden Ritual, Devour Magic, Tentacle of Yogg-Saron, Satiate, Dark Infusion confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Malevolence applies Black Blood (a HoT that jumps to nearby allies) as its main throughput, Gaze of C'Thun banks direct heals into Void-Touched stacks then cashes them in - healing comes out of damage, standing in the fight is part of the model.

nodes.name: Shadow Training
nodes.description: Increases Eldritch Mending and Gaze of C'Thun healing. Your heals cannot be parried or dodged. +3% Eldritch Mending healing.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Boosts Eldritch Mending + Gaze of C'Thun healing; guaranteed hit, can't be parried/dodged.'

nodes.name: Void Power
nodes.description: Increases healing power gained from main-hand weapon damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Healing power from main-hand weapon damage.' Confirms melee-weapon-gated healing, the class's signature no-retail-analog trait.

nodes.name: Well Educated
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: As The Prophecy Foretold
nodes.description: Your critical strikes steady your mind, restoring 55 Mana. No more than once per turn.
nodes._source:
WAS an invented node called 'Sanity': 45 Mana on EVERY heal cast, 100% chance, no internal cooldown, one point. No talent of that name exists anywhere in CoA's Cultist data, and the effect is a closed loop - the cast pays for itself - which is why Heretic measured ~3000x the healing-per-resource of every other healer in the game and never ran dry while Shaman Restoration runs out in 12 turns and Resto Druid in 7. Ritual of Awakening healed 2232 for a net 8 Mana.

CoA funds this spec's mana from MELEE DAMAGE, not from healing, in two places: Sanity Tap (an ability - spend 20 Insanity for 20% of your MISSING mana, self-limiting and worth nothing at full mana) and this talent, 'Melee critical strikes now refresh a charge of Blade of the Empire and restore 3% of your base mana.' Gating the refund on crits with a one-turn cooldown ties sustain to melee uptime, which is the design.

NOT FULLY FAITHFUL: grant_resource takes a flat amount with optional scale_talent_key scaling, so 'percentage of base mana' is not expressible - 55 is ~3% of a level 60 Cultist's base pool, so it is right at 60 and generous at low level. The Blade of the Empire charge refresh has no proc shape either.

nodes.name: Abyssal Guard
nodes.description: Eldritch Mending costs 5% less Mana per rank, and each heal you cast has a 20% chance per rank to raise an Abyssal Guard around you, absorbing damage equal to 4% of your maximum health for 3 turns.

nodes.name: Devour Curse
nodes.description: Learn Devour Curse, dispelling a curse from an ally and healing yourself.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Dispels curses from an ally, heals you.'

nodes.name: Greater Void Blessing
nodes.description: Learn Greater Void Blessing, a party-wide mana regeneration buff.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid mana regen buff.'

nodes.name: Herald of the Depths
nodes.description: Spending Insanity on Eldritch Shock, Wrath of the Black Empire, Void Embrace or Sanity Tap marks you as a Herald, granting 50 healing power and 30 spell power for 3 turns. Cannot occur more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Reaching 100 Insanity no longer causes Total Madness. Teaches Herald of the Depths.' Also unlocks the active window that amplifies output and stretches HoTs/shields.

nodes.name: Malevolence
nodes.description: Learn Malevolence, dealing Shadow damage and applying Black Blood, a repeating heal-over-time to nearby allies. Usable while moving.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, Generates 10 Insanity, '56 Shadow damage and applying Black Blood to 5 nearby allies, healing them for 40, repeating every 3 sec for 12 sec.' Heretic's real main-throughput ability.

nodes.name: Void Shield
nodes.description: Learn Void Shield, shielding an ally and applying Wracked Mind, preventing another Void Shield on them for a duration.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 'Shields an ally, absorbing 241 damage for 30 sec and applying Wracked Mind. Wracked Mind: Cannot be affected by Void Shield. Lasts for 15 sec.'

nodes.name: Blade of Yogg-Saron
nodes.description: Your Blade of the Empire drains 20% of the damage it deals as healing to your most wounded ally.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a core Strength: 'Blade of the Empire damage heals lowest-health ally (% of damage + flat bonus).' Turns the class-wide melee generator into a real heal for this spec.

nodes.name: Forbidden Ritual
nodes.description: Learn Forbidden Ritual, chanting a ritual that shields all nearby party and raid members.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 'Chant a forbidden ritual that places a shield on all nearby party and raid members that absorbs 308 damage for 10 sec.'

nodes.name: Abyssal Covenant
nodes.description: Link to an ally, transferring a percentage of their damage taken to you and converting a percentage of your damage into healing for them. Only one ally at a time.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Heretic's signature link mechanic: 'Links to an ally: transfers a % of their damage taken to you; a % of your damage converts to their healing. One ally at a time.' Referenced repeatedly as the spec's standout tank-protection tool.

nodes.name: Dark Veil
nodes.description: Channel a stacking shield on you and a target ally, granting stun and silence immunity while channeling.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Channeled shield: you+target absorb damage (stacking, periodic); at end, shield holds + you teleport to them. Grants immunity while channeling.' Real protect-a-focus-target tool.

nodes.name: Void Embrace
nodes.description: Consume a large amount of Insanity to repeatedly heal nearby allies, applying Void-Touched with each tick.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Consumes 60 Insanity. Repeating heal to nearby allies, applies Void-Touched with each tick.' Heretic's real capstone Insanity spender.

nodes.name: Dark Infusion
nodes.description: Learn Dark Infusion, pre-loading a heal on an ally's next damage taken, which then spreads to the two lowest-health nearby allies.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot (class-wide entry, also referenced as a spec-relevant pre-shield tool): 3 charges, 30 sec recharge, pre-heal spreading to the two lowest-health allies.

nodes.name: Entropic Host
nodes.description: Learn Entropic Host, a repeating heal-over-time that jumps to another ally when it expires.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Repeating HoT; at expiry jumps to another ally; after 2 jumps, target can't be affected again.'

nodes.name: Dark Matter
nodes.description: Reduces Satiate's cooldown by 5% per rank and gives it a 20% chance per rank to also mend your most wounded ally for 120.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Satiate channel heals nearby allies periodically.'

nodes.name: Isolate
nodes.description: Learn Isolate, reducing a target's threat, causing enemies to stop attacking them and cancelling their current casts.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as real threat-drop utility, called out for never using on the tank: 'Reduces threat, causes enemies to stop attacking target + cancels current casts on them.'

nodes.name: Ritual of Awakening
nodes.description: Learn Ritual of Awakening, a battle resurrection usable only out of combat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Battle-rez. Out of combat.'

nodes.name: Protection From Light
nodes.description: Reduces Holy and Fire damage taken for a target ally, and periodically heals them while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces Holy+Fire damage taken for an ally; periodic heal while active.'

nodes.name: Saronite Mind
nodes.description: Eldritch Shock's cooldown is reduced by 33%, and each Eldritch Shock that lands returns 10 Insanity.

nodes.name: Instill Despair
nodes.description: Increases your Haste by 1% per rank. Your damaging casts have a 10% chance per rank to steal life, healing you for 60.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ally weapon defiled: boosts haste + steal-health-on-damage chance (heals for half stolen).'

nodes.name: Summon: Mindbender
nodes.description: Learn Summon: Mindbender, a minion that periodically heals nearby allies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Summons a minion that periodically heals nearby allies.'

nodes.name: Hymn of Hope
nodes.description: Increases the healing power of Malevolence's Black Blood effect by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Faith Unbroken
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Grace of the Deep
nodes.description: Increases healing done to targets below 50% health by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Blasphemy
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
